instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, full shot at eye-level. In a dry grassy field under a clear blue sky, the man in the denim jacket (R2) stands in the center, carrying the woman in the shearling-lined denim jacket (R1) bridal-style in his arms. She smiles joyfully with her brown hair tossing in the air, while he smiles back at her. Bright natural sunlight fills the scene, casting soft shadows on the dry grass and creating a lively, romantic atmosphere.
